info.description: Open 120B-parameter vision-language model with 12B active parameters, under the OpenMDW-1.1 license. It accepts text, images, and video and returns text; the announcement also describes webpage and PDF understanding, with documents supplied as page images. The weights card says context is up to 1M tokens, and one TensorRT-LLM example sets max_seq_len to 1048576. The NVIDIA NIM catalog lists 262K for the hosted endpoint. Those figures conflict, so the context limit is unset. Reasoning is switched with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking; medium effort sets medium_effort to true. No official API token price is published.

zh.description: 开放的 120B 视觉语言模型，激活参数 12B，许可证为 OpenMDW-1.1。输入为文本、图像和视频，输出为文本；公告还写到网页与 PDF 理解，文档以页面图像提供。权重卡写上下文最高 1M tokens，一份 TensorRT-LLM 示例把 max_seq_len 设为 1048576。NVIDIA NIM 目录把托管端点标为 262K。两处数字冲突，因此上下文上限留空。推理用 chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking 开关；中等强度另设 medium_effort 为 true。官方未公布 API token 标准价。
